description: This file defines a TaskRegistry class for managing task functions in the Global Task Framework (GTF). It includes methods for registering, retrieving, checking, listing, and clearing tasks, with logging for each operation.

classes.name: TaskRegistry
classes.description: A class that manages registration and retrieval of task functions, supporting operations like register, get_executor, is_registered, list_tasks, and clear.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a task function with a unique name, raising an error if the name is already registered with a different function.

methods.name: get_executor
methods.description: Retrieves the registered task function by name, raising an error if not found.

methods.name: is_registered
methods.description: Checks if a task name is already registered.

methods.name: list_tasks
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of all registered task names.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all registered tasks; mainly for testing purposes.
